scripts.sync:android: npm run prepare:android && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.sync:ios: npm run prepare:android && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' build
scripts.test: node --check service-worker.js && for f in js/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && python3 -m json.tool manifest.webmanifest > /dev/null
